context: A named bard and caravan captain. Agraband is an invented given name; Swift is a meaningful English surname. A natural fantasy localization of the surname is welcome.
A female scout from a riverside family. Mara is her given name. Reed is a meaningful surname derived from the reeds near their home, and may be localized naturally as a fantasy surname.
A named woman with an epithet describing her ash-grey hair. Tamsin is an invented given name; the Ashen is a descriptive epithet.
A male dwarf called Ironhand because he has an iron prosthetic hand. Borun is his invented given name; Ironhand is a transparent nickname.
An invented personal name with no known meaning or etymology. There is no descriptive epithet.
Neris is a personal given name. Shade is inherited from an unknown ancient language; its resemblance to the English word shade is coincidental, and no shadow-related meaning is established.
A ship captain now addressed by his captain title. Use his already established localized name consistently.
A historic settlement. Carinth is an opaque invented root.
